name: Bound Between Desks
detailed_description:
Welcome to a world where the line between reality and mysticism blurs!

Bound Between Desks is a captivating visual novel that transforms ordinary school life into a mystical adventure filled with secrets and unexpected twists. Your choices will determine not only the protagonist's fate but also unveil the deep mysteries hidden behind the walls of what seems to be an ordinary school.

Key Features

Deep Characters with Hidden Secrets Meet unique characters, each harboring their own mysteries. Build relationships, explore motivations, and remember—every interaction can dramatically alter the course of the story.

Atmosphere of Tense Mysticism The school holds countless mysteries, and the boundary between reality and the supernatural grows ever thinner. Will you uncover the truth, or will your actions lead to even darker revelations?

Every Choice Matters Your decisions have real consequences. The game features over 4 unique endings with multiple variations—each playthrough will reveal new facets of the story.

Stunning Anime-Style Visuals Immerse yourself in an atmospheric world through stylish graphics and thoughtful artistic design. Every scene is crafted for maximum immersion into the school's mysterious atmosphere.

Soul-Stirring Soundtrack Experience an emotionally captivating musical score that perfectly complements every moment of tension, mystery, and revelation. The carefully crafted soundtrack draws you deeper into the story, enhancing every emotional beat and atmospheric scene.

What Awaits You

  • Cross-Platform Gaming: Play on Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android

  • Rich Storyline: 6 chapters of gripping narrative

  • Multiple Endings: Discover all secrets through various story paths

  • Full Localization: Complete support for Russian and English languages(will add other after release)

Genre and Atmosphere

Bound Between Desks masterfully combines elements of mystery, horror, and psychological drama. The game creates a unique atmosphere of uncertainty where every school corridor might hide a new secret, and every character may harbor an unexpected mystery.

If you appreciate quality visual novels with deep storylines, meaningful choices, and an atmosphere of intrigue—Bound Between Desks will be the perfect choice for an unforgettable gaming experience.

Uncover all the secrets. Make your choice. Change destiny.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8 / 10 / 11
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual Core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics or better
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: 2.4 GHz Dual Core or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated or integrated GPU
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core M or Apple M1
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Runs via Rosetta on Apple Silicon

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 or later
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual Core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0 compatible
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains dark and emotionally intense themes, including psychological horror and disturbing atmosphere. While no explicit content is present, certain scenes may be unsettling or uncomfortable for sensitive players.
